ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... Drawer 8 holds the Poland file. ... Drawer 2 holds the Lebanon file. ... Drawer 6 holds the Spain file. ... In which drawer is the file on the country whose capital is Beirut?" -> answer org 2; the alt prompt asks about the Spain (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: 6 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 8 (answer at the same statement slot), 7 (the alt prompt's own answer), 2 (answer org kept).
